limitations: No listening or human audiovisual QA performed; automated technical checks are separate.
Earlier unapproved indirect headless-browser use remains recorded. The owner later authorized automated browser verification for the completion pass only.
Local opt-in pinned Python runtime only; GPL/transitive distribution decision remains pending. No backend dependency binaries bundled.
